messages:
maria: quick sync — prod alert: tenant with residency=STRICT got writes rejected after a proxy handoff. client cookie still hit same proxy id but the pod's backing region tag had changed. legal guard denied. anyone seen this pattern?
ajay: saw it in a canary. rotation moved pods across nodepools and instance-region metadata flipped while sticky session mapping stayed.
leila: so fast-rotate (no-drain) is the culprit for workloads that require server-side residency enforcement?
samir: yes. fast-rotate assumes session residency is implicit or client-provided. when we have server-side legal checks that compare request region to instance tag, reschedules break that invariant.
maria: could we carry a session-scoped residency assertion instead of relying on instance tags? e.g., header x-residency-lease: <signed-blob> containing region id + nonce + ttl, issued by control plane. proxies validate locally.
ajay: agree. implementation note: sign with ed25519, short TTL (2-5m). proxies can cache validated leases per-session id to avoid verifying on every token.
leila: compliance: leases must not include tenant PII. region taxonomy needs to be explicit in RFC (cloud-region vs legal-jurisdiction). also state fallback policy on verification failure.
samir: key rotation: proxies should pull public keys periodically and accept previous keys for overlap window. operator runbook must include key-rollback steps.
maria: policy choices: EU clusters default-deny on verification failure; global clusters start log-only then allow for a canary period. legal prefers deny; ops prefers gradual rollout. hybrid sounds best.
ajay: perf check: ed25519 verify is cheap but still add an LRU cache keyed by session id -> verified lease until expiry. bench locally to confirm.
leila: telemetry we need: lease_verify_fail, lease_mismatch_count, lease_expiry_histogram. dashboard tile and an alert threshold (suggest 0.05% over 5m for high-traffic clusters).
samir: short-term mitigation: force-drain rotations for tenants with residency=STRICT (low blast), and enable a log-only enforcement mode for a subset of tenants so we can observe false positives.
sre-bot: Canary test summary: staging fast-rotate caused 0.18% residency-mismatch errors; automated rollback occurred.
maria: action items: 1) RFC draft for "residency leases" with sequence diagram and region taxonomy (maria), 2) proxy verifier prototype + small LRU cache (ajay), 3) lease-issuer API + key-rotation + runbook (samir), 4) compliance doc + acceptable TTLs (leila). I'll open an ops PR to force-drain STRICT tenants today.
ajay: I'll aim for a prototype lib in the proxy runtime (2d) and a PoC dashboard for telemetry.
samir: I'll sketch issuer load model and include verification latency numbers in the RFC appendix. also add operator rollback steps if we mis-issue leases.
leila: ping me when RFC is ready so legal can sign off on region definitions and fallback policy.
maria: thanks team. will post RFC link in this thread within 48h. :thumbsup:
